fields.statement: At d5ab5678 ran go test -trimpath -count=1 -v ./internal/gosweep/...: all 4 tests pass, plus go vet and gofmt -l clean. TestSweepDirsRemovesOnlyStale builds a fake GOCACHE and TMPDIR with os.Chtimes back-dated (4h, 5h) and fresh (1h) shard entries, a 9h-old top-level README, an old (3h) and a fresh (30m) go-build* folder and an old other-old folder; SweepDirs removes only the two stale shard entries and the old go-build111 and reports Freed{CacheEntries:2, CacheBytes:30, TempFolders:1, TempBytes:100}. TestCacheOffTouchesNoEntry sets GOCACHE=off: CacheDir() is empty and no cache entry is removed, though the old temp folder still goes. Read the diff: the cutoffs are 3h for the cache and 2h for temp folders; the cache dir is $GOCACHE, else os.UserCacheDir()/go-build; only entries in two-hex shard folders are removed, so trim.txt, README and fuzz/ stay; the temp sweep covers only go-build* folders directly under os.TempDir(). This matches the leaf statement and the go-cache-sweep-shape decision.
